prompt: I need to find all open issues labeled 'bug' in our repo that were created in the last month, and output them as a simple table with issue number, title, and assignee. Then close all the ones that are also labeled 'stale' with a comment saying we're cleaning up old bugs.

assertions.text: Uses gh issue list with --label bug and --state open
Filters by creation date (last month) using --search or --jq
assertions.rationale: User asked for issues created in the last month — needs date filtering

assertions.text: Uses --json with number, title, and assignees fields
assertions.rationale: User wants a table with these specific columns

assertions.text: Uses --jq or column formatting to produce readable table output
assertions.rationale: User asked for 'a simple table' — needs formatting beyond raw JSON

assertions.text: Uses a pipeline (xargs or loop) to close stale issues in bulk
assertions.rationale: Closing multiple issues requires iteration over the filtered set

assertions.text: The close command includes --comment with a cleanup message
assertions.rationale: User specified a comment about cleaning up old bugs

assertions.text: Warns about irreversibility or suggests a dry-run/preview before bulk close
assertions.rationale: Bulk closing issues is a destructive operation — good practice to preview first
